Then handle_user_queries: first check pending_query (none), then selected_question (set!) -> handle_non_streaming_query, st.rerun(). So we never render chat_input in that run - we process and rerun. Good.

After that run we rerun again. Now selected_question is None. We have 2 messages (user + assistant). We render chat_history (both messages), then handle_user_queries: render chat_input. So we're good.

I will run the app to verify and fix any issues. First I will check if there are linter errors and if question_generator has the right prompt path (it uses parents[3] from processing/ - processing is backend/business/rag_engine/processing, so parents[3] = backend, then prompts/question/generate.txt - but prompts is at project root, not under backend. So path should be Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / "prompts" - from backend/business/rag_engine/processing/question_generator.py, parents[0]=processing, parents[1]=rag_engine, parents[2]=business, parents[3]=backend. So we get backend/prompts but prompts is at project root. So the path is wrong!)
